test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A runner starts running from a point at 5 : 00 am at the speed of 10 km/hr. Second runner starts from the same from the same point at 8 : 00 am in the same direction with a speed of 15 km/hr. At what time of of the day will the second runner will overtake the first runner?
solution:
**Given:**

The speed of the first runner = 10 km/hr

Speed of second runner = 15 km/hr

**Calculation:**

Distance covered by the first runner from 5:00 to 8:00 am

= 3 x 10

= 30 km

The relative speed of the second runner w.r.t to the first runner

= 15 - 10

= 5 km/hr

Taking the first runner to be at rest, the second runner has to cover 5 km to catch up to the first runner.

Time taken by second runner to catch up to first runner = 30/5 hr = 6 hr

So, Required time = 8:00 am + 6 hr

= 2: 00 pm

**The required time is 2:00 pm.**
